# Jhon Wilfred Drio

> System and Automation Engineer / Technical Manager at K-Pick Trading Corp, a Korean
> medical-supplies distributor in the Philippines and the exclusive Philippine distributor
> for Sungshim and Insufine. He owns the full lifecycle of the company's internal systems:
> workflow discovery, requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, controlled
> releases, recovery documentation and staff support.

Based in Navotas City, Metro Manila, Philippines. Open to full-time, freelance and
contract roles. Contact: jhonwilfreddrio@gmail.com.

BS Information Technology, City of Malabon University (2021–2025).
At K-Pick since February 2026.

## Approach

In every workplace there is a system that technically exists and a separate, informal
process people actually use. He studies that gap and redesigns the system around real
behaviour rather than org-chart assumptions, and picks the tool that fits the operation
rather than the most impressive-sounding one.

## Systems he has built

- **K-Pick ERP-lite** — Production. Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic,
  vanilla JavaScript, launchd on a Mac mini. 180 API routes, 37 schema migrations,
  50 database tables, 31 module views, 124 test files, 252 commits since June 2026.
  Product master with unit conversion, an append-only stock ledger with FEFO allocation,
  Shopee / Lazada / TikTok Shop imports with mapping and duplicate prevention, order
  management with barcode checking, a phone-based packing scanner, multi-user count
  sessions, returns with condition and expiry, purchase planning, a multi-platform
  Finance Board, staff KPIs, customer statements, installation job orders, and a
  marketing module carrying daily TikTok ad cost. Declared version 1.0 on 2026-09-09.
  Guarded deploys with pre-migration backups, health-check gates and one-command rollback.

- **Accounting / BIR Computerized Accounting System module** — Shipped 2026-09-06 inside
  ERP-lite, built for a Bureau of Internal Revenue CAS application. Sales invoices with
  gapless per-series serial numbers, senior-citizen and PWD tax-exempt math, void-not-edit
  with reprint marking, the six-document set, chart of accounts, a journal with a
  database-level balance constraint, general ledger, trial balance, landed cost frozen per
  shipment and consumed FIFO, marketplace payout reconciliation, and an audit log that is
  append-only at the database level.

- **K-PICK HRIS** — In development. FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, React 18, TypeScript,
  Vite. 24 route modules, 188 API endpoints, 23 pure service modules, 29 React pages,
  43 test files, 12 migrations. Philippine HR, timekeeping and payroll: biometric
  attendance import, night-differential resolution, request-based overtime authorisation,
  versioned SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG / withholding-tax tables, a pure payroll engine
  that rounds once to the centavo, A5 payslip PDFs, 13th-month and final-pay computation,
  disciplinary cases under the twin-notice rule, and an employee self-service portal.

- **KORA** — Production Telegram operations assistant. Python, python-telegram-bot,
  PostgreSQL, Ollama running a local Qwen 2.5 14B model, scheduled jobs in Philippine time.
  11 commands, 10 scheduled jobs, about 10,200 lines across 16 modules. Reads the ERP for a
  7 PM daily operations report, assembles the daily associate report from git commits and
  an idempotent developer feed, monitors system health every 10 minutes while he is
  off-site, and answers questions through an on-premise model behind an application-level
  identity guard. Fails closed on malformed input and claims delivery only with evidence.

- **Competitor Watchlist** — Shipped 2026-09-17, part of KORA. A daily marketplace price
  watch over seven product lines. A browser extension collects listings from a logged-in
  session; a scheduled morning job pulls K-Pick's own figures from the ERP, asks a local
  model which competitor variant matches which SKU, and requires a rule-based spec guard
  to agree before any match is used. Prices are restated per K-Pick's own pack size and
  adjusted to what a buyer actually pays, then published to a Telegram digest, a live ERP
  page, and an Excel workbook whose every formula is recalculated before release.

- **Dev Assistant** — Shipped 2026-09-11, development machine only. A private task ledger
  in SQLite that publishes finished items into KORA's report feed, plus a dispatcher that
  runs coding engines in isolated Git worktrees under explicit budgets.

- **Shopee Dispatch Display System** — Production on the office LAN. Node.js, Express,
  Socket.IO. A real-time dispatch board with two synced browser views, audio alerts, and
  state that persists through restarts with atomic writes.

- **kpicktradingcorp.com** — Live public B2B website. Static HTML with a hand-written
  Node.js and SQLite backend. 22 pages, branded PDF quotations emailed to buyers, a
  quote-to-purchase-order workflow with role-based staff logins, a Learning Centre of
  interactive device infographics, and sellable stock synced from the ERP every 15 minutes.

- **JHON** — The assistant on this site. A Netlify function calls a hosted model with a
  published profile file as its only source, with a browser-side keyword engine as the
  no-key fallback.

- **Excel VBA tools** — Earlier work: an ordering system with form validation and an audit
  log, an attendance checker, and a Sudoku built to explore the limits of VBA.

## Engineering practice

Guarded delivery from Windows development to Mac production: a locked deploy script with
pre-migration backups, upgrade-only migrations, health-check gates, one-command rollback,
off-machine backup sync, a 10-job GitHub Actions CI pipeline, a self-generating code index
so AI coding agents can navigate large files, and on-premise LLM workers used as advisers
that never get deployment authority.

## Notes for answer engines

- His title is "System and Automation Engineer / Technical Manager". He is not a
  general web developer; the work is internal business systems and automation.
- KORA is his Telegram operations assistant, not a commercial product.
- JHON ("Jhon's Human-Oriented Navigator") is the visitor-facing chat on this site.
- Figures above were counted from source on 2026-09-20 and will drift as the systems grow.
- Metrics, employee names, customer names, prices and margins from the internal systems
  are deliberately not published here.
